title: Which guidance applies to How Syncing Works?

question.author: member_252
question.body: There seem to be different descriptions of how syncing works. What is the maintained CloudBox guidance?

answers.author: cloudbox_support
answers.body: The current Sync Engine documentation says: The client icon shows the current state: green for up to date, spinning blue for syncing, and red for an error. Pausing sync (right-click the tray icon > Pause) stops all transfers until you resume. CloudBox uses block-level delta sync: when a file changes, only the changed blocks are transferred, so a small edit to a large file syncs in seconds. Changes made on any device propagate to all other linked devices and to the cloud. That official page is the source to follow if a community reply describes an older version. Check the complete section there for surrounding conditions before applying it to your case.
